Hi Sarah / Tom — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side:

- Attached: Draft_MAP_AstraMed_v1.2.xlsx — milestone rows filled with owners and target dates as discussed.
- Target close date: you mentioned aiming for contract signature by 2027-05-06 to align with your Q2 procurement window. We captured that as the primary target.
- Key dependencies we noted: internal security review (AstraMed Sec team), PO issuance, and legal redlines.

Immediate asks: could you confirm the procurement signature deadline (is 2027-05-06 firm?), and please flag any additional stakeholders we should include on the MAP (legal contact, procurement PO owner).

Proposed next steps:
1) Redline MAP with any date/owner changes and return by Thu 4/15.
2) Redwood to route a short SOW excerpt to your legal team by 4/16 for early review (attached snippet).
3) Quick alignment call Wed 4/21 if there are substantive redlines.

If 5/6 is optimistic, tell us the latest acceptable date and we'll update the plan.

Thanks —

Stephanie — thanks for the recap and the draft. A few clarifications from our side:

- Procurement signature: 2027-05-06 is the internal target (end of our fiscal quarter) but it is not yet locked. Primary risk is our security questionnaire sign-off — that typically takes 10 business days once we have the SOW and any supporting artifacts.
- Legal contact: Laura Mitchell (laura.mitchell@astramed.com) should be looped for contract redlines. Procurement owner (PO) is Tom Nguyen — I'm cc'ing him.

We'll review the attached MAP and return a redlined copy by Thu 4/15 EOD if possible. If security requests additional evidence, that could push the signature to the week of 5/10 — we can confirm after the questionnaire is open.

Thanks,

Head of Partnerships | AstraMed Health

Hi team — quick note from Legal after skimming the SOW excerpt: 

- We should reserve 3 business days for standard contract redline turnaround internally, plus expect 1-2 exchange cycles with AstraMed legal. If Laura Mitchell pushes non-standard terms, that will add time.
- Suggest we mark a buffer around the target signature date (5/06) — propose a "contract freeze" milestone on the MAP dated 2027-05-03 to capture final redline agreement and DocuSign prep.
- Also recommend we include a contingency milestone: "Fallback: interim pilot agreement" if signature slips past 5/13. That keeps the technical onboarding schedule moving.

I added these notes to the attached MAP draft (see Draft_MAP_AstraMed_v1.2.xlsx). If Procurement insists 5/06 is immovable, we need a rapid security questionnaire response plan — recommend assigning a single Redwood SME for evidence drops.

—Laura
